book.name: Taalie
book.title: Ala xa Taalie Ala xa Taalie

content.text: Setare tinxinxi fan xaxilitare wule falɛ bɛ.
Gbatafe ra i mu naxan kolon, a mixi ratantanma nɛ.
Adamadi a yɛtɛ xun nakanama nɛ a xa daxuɲa ra,
kɔnɔ a fa a bɔɲɛ rate Alatala tan ma na xunnakanɛ xa fe ra.
Bannaya a niyama nɛ mixi xa boore gbegbe sɔtɔ,
kɔnɔ setareɲa dɛfanbooreɲa kanama nɛ.
Tɔɔɲɛgɛti fama nɛ ɲaxankatɛ sɔtɔde,
wule falɛ mu kisima.
Mixi gbegbe katama e yɛtɛ rafande kinikinintee ma,
birin birama nɛ mixi fɔxɔ ra naxan ki tima.
Setare mu rafan a ngaxakerenyie yati ma,
a mu rafan a booree fan ma.
A na e maxandi, e mu e tuli matima a ra.
Mixi naxan xaxili fenma, a fe fanyi rabama nɛ a yɛtɛ bɛ.
Mixi naxan fahaamui fenma, a xa fe sɔɔnɛyama nɛ.
Tɔɔɲɛgɛti fama nɛ ɲaxankatɛ sɔtɔde,
halaki birama nɛ wule falɛ fɔxɔ ra.
Naafuli mu lan xaxilitare yi ra,
alɔ a to mu lan konyi fan xa kuntigie yaamari.
Lɔnnila bɔɲɛ te xɔnɔ, a mu konbi ragbilenma.
Na kui a binyɛ sɔtɔma nɛ.
Mangɛ xa xɔnɛ maniya yɛtɛ xaaɲɛ ra,
a xa hinnɛ fan maniya xini ra burɛxɛ xinde ma.
Di xaxilitare kɔntɔfili nan bɛndunma a baba ma,
ginɛ xa sɔnxɔɛ xunxuri luxi nɛ alɔ ye
naxan luma mini ra fɛɲɛ yale di kui, a mu a itima.
Mixi banxi nun harige sɔtɔma e baba kɛ ra,
kɔnɔ Ala nan ginɛ xaxilima fima xɛmɛ ma.
Tunnaxɔnɛ mixi luma nɛ xixɔli kui,
a kaamɛ nan tun sɔtɔma.
Mixi naxan Ala xa sɛriyɛ rabatuma,
a a yɛtɛ ratangama nɛ faxɛ ma,
kɔnɔ naxan mu a ɲɛngi sama a ɲɛrɛ ki xɔn ma,
a faxama nɛ.
Setare kife na maniyaxi Alatala donife nan na.
Ala fama nɛ na doni ragbilende a ma.
I xa fe birin naba i xa di xurufe ra alako a xa kisi,
xa na mu a ra, a faxama nɛ.
Mixi naxan luma xɔnɔ ra, a na sare fima nɛ.
Xa i a mali keren, a man gbilenma nɛ na ma.
I xa i tuli mati marasi ra, i xa tin e xa i xaran,
alako i xa findi xaxilima ra.
Maɲɔxun gbegbe na mixi bɔɲɛ kui,
kɔnɔ Alatala waxɔnfe nan kamalima.
Adamadi wama a boore xa dugutɛgɛɲa a ma.
Setare fisa wule falɛ bɛ.
Alatala xa yaragaaxui mixi rakisima nɛ.
Na mixi na a sa kɔɛ ra, a mu hanmɛma tɔɔrɛ yo ra.
Tunnaxɔnɛ a donse tongoma nɛ a bɛlɛxɛ,
kɔnɔ a mu wakilima a rasofe ra a dɛ i.
Mixi mayele bɔnbɔ, alako xaxilitare xa xaxili sɔtɔ.
Xaxilima na rasi, alako a xaxili xun xa masa.
Di naxan a baba kasarama, a a nga keri,
mixi rayaagixi na a ra.
N ma di, xa i mu marasi ramɛma,
i bara i yɛtɛ makuya fe kolonyi ra.
Seede wule falɛ yoma sɛriyɛ nan ma,
tinxintareya nan minima mixi ɲaaxi dɛ i.
Mixi mayele ɲaxankatama nɛ,
lɔnnitare bɔnbɔma nɛ.
